PCB trace is 13.84mm long, exceeding the 10mm maximum
J1 sits 0.349mm from the board edge; the assembly line grips the outer 2.5mm and needs 1mm as an absolute floor
U3 sits exactly on the 0.4mm pitch floor — legal, with no margin for a footprint revision

15 part(s) are in package families whose zero-rotation convention differs between EDA output and JLCPCB's library: D10, D11, D12, D13, D14, D15, D16, D17, J1, LED1, U1, U2, U4, U5, Y1. Check pin-1 on each in the placement preview before paying — that screen is the only place this is catchable
GND is routed at 0.150mm, which carries 604mA at a 10degC rise (IPC-2221B, 1oz external). It has to carry 649mA (the return path for every rail; the heaviest is V5 at 649mA), which needs 0.165mm
V5 is routed at 0.150mm, which carries 604mA at a 10degC rise (IPC-2221B, 1oz external). It has to carry 649mA (U1 0.001mA; U2 11mA; U5 11mA; 136mA drawn through U2 from V3_3), which needs 0.165mm
USB_DP routes 68.71mm and USB_DM 49.49mm — 19.22mm of intra-pair skew against a 3.8mm budget (USB 2.0, ~150ps on FR-4). Length-match the pair or shorten the longer leg

every routed segment on this board is 0.15mm — the same copper for GND, V3_3, V3_3_LED, V5 as for a button signal. No net class distinguishes power from signal, so each rail carries whatever the router's default happens to be (604mA at 10degC by IPC-2221B)
